title: Implement the portable command service contract
description: Implement story plx-48b1ee as a provider-neutral application service and durable repository contract with executable behavior specifications. Cover tenant scoping, structured submission, service-owned identity/time, idempotent duplicate submission, idempotency conflicts, status lookup, cancellation state, and atomic dispatch discoverability. Do not add HTTP, AWS, Kubernetes, dashboard, Celery, or provider storage implementations.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementation started on feature/portable-command-service-api. Scope is restricted to the clean provider-neutral submission/status/cancellation contract, tenant scoping, schema-v2 envelope, idempotency, and repository semantics. No HTTP, cloud, dashboard, Celery, migration, or provider code is authorized.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the provider-neutral command service contract with authenticated immutable context, resource-aware versioned authorization decisions, principal-scoped idempotency, bounded canonical request digests, atomic repository semantics, tenant non-disclosure, payload-free audit events, safe cancellation transitions, and durable execution-integrity requirements. Local validation: conda run -n py311 behave tests/command_worker/features (29 scenarios, 128 steps passed); conda run -n py311 python -m pytest -q tests/command_worker (80 passed); conda run -n py311 python -m pytest -q tests/cli/test_cli_imports_only.py (7 passed, 7 existing Pydantic deprecation warnings); ruff check plexus/command_worker tests/command_worker; ruff format --check plexus/command_worker tests/command_worker; git diff --check. Direct review corrections completed before acceptance.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Landed in Plexus develop via PR #538. The provider-neutral command service contract and local validation evidence are now merged.
